scope: Fresh exact frozen source, offline pinned GCC or uniquely tagged PGO production image on emulated Linux/amd64. Output/build/sandbox proof only; no Intel timing or organizer binary claim.
deduplication: One invocation per complete input-content hash, worker count and expected output hash; historical aliases are not counted as independent executions.
default_selection: Risk-based actual no-argument/no-thread-override entrypoint checks. Complete archived+fresh bank is separately replayed in production image mode.
